skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces for web components, pages, and applications.
skill.summary: Guides polished frontend implementation with a clear visual direction and strong design quality.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: The three static findings are false positives caused by frontend design guidance, not system reconnaissance. The skill is prose-only and contains no evidence of command execution, data exfiltration, prompt injection, or unsafe operational intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 describes the goal of producing distinctive frontend interfaces. It does not ask the model to inspect the host system, enumerate files, or collect environment data.
Line 30 gives typography guidance and examples of fonts to avoid. This is design advice, not reconnaissance or access to system information.
Line 34 recommends visual background techniques such as textures and shadows. No instruction requests system discovery, secret access, or external communication.

content.value_statement: Many AI-generated interfaces look generic and miss the product context. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce polished frontends with a clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear aesthetic direction before coding.
Encourages production-grade HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue implementations.
Defines typography, color, motion, layout, and background design priorities.
Steers outputs away from generic AI interface patterns.
Matches implementation complexity to minimalist or maximalist design goals.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a reusable component library.
It does not include generated assets, templates, or executable scripts.
Final accessibility, browser support, and performance still require project testing.
It cannot replace specific brand guidelines or user research.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Product Screen
use_cases.description: Create a functional first version of a product screen with a memorable visual direction.

use_cases.title: Upgrade an Existing Interface
use_cases.description: Improve visual hierarchy, motion, typography, and spacing while preserving existing product behavior.

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Directions
use_cases.description: Generate a focused interface concept that tests a strong aesthetic direction for a product idea.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Page Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused frontend section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to create a polished [section type] for [product]. Audience: [audience]. Tone: [tone]. Framework: [framework].

prompt_templates.title: Design an App Dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a functional application view.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to build a dashboard for [workflow]. Include key states, responsive layout, clear hierarchy, and a distinctive visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign Component Screens
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for improving an existing interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to redesign these screens: [screen list]. Preserve behavior and improve typography, spacing, motion, color, and visual identity.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Experience
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete visual direction and implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to define an aesthetic direction and implement a multi-section [page or app]. Explain the design choices before coding.

output_examples.input: Create a homepage for a premium analytics tool.
output_examples.output: A refined interface with distinctive typography, sharp data areas, focused calls to action, and a production-ready component structure.

output_examples.input: Redesign onboarding for a developer tool.
output_examples.output: A concise flow with clear states, purposeful motion, and visual details that avoid generic software patterns.

output_examples.input: Build a concept page for a music discovery app.
output_examples.output: An expressive page direction with bold composition, contextual textures, strong color choices, and responsive interaction states.

best_practices: Provide audience, product context, and framework constraints.
Ask for one clear aesthetic direction before implementation begins.
Review final output for accessibility, responsive behavior, and performance.
anti_patterns: Requesting a vague modern design without product context.
Mixing many visual styles in one interface.
Treating the skill as a substitute for production quality assurance.

faq.question: Does this skill write working frontend code?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides the model to produce functional frontend implementations, not only design descriptions.

faq.question: Which frameworks can it support?
faq.answer: The instructions mention HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and Vue as suitable implementation targets.

faq.question: Is this a design system package?
faq.answer: No. It is guidance for creating distinctive interfaces, not a packaged component library.

faq.question: Can it help avoid generic AI design?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill specifically directs the model away from common fonts, palettes, layouts, and repeated patterns.

faq.question: Does it include security-sensitive code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill contains only design guidance in SKILL.md and no executable scripts.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when building or redesigning a frontend component, page, application view, or interactive interface.
